globalRule: Every sample image must feel like a relatable real-life memory users could have in their phone: people from behind/silhouettes/hands, everyday objects, rooms, food, streets, travel traces, candid composition. Avoid generic scenery-only, sterile stock, logos, readable text, recognizable faces, celebrity likeness, and uncanny AI hands/faces.
